data.revised_prompt:
Create a production-ready 3x3 cat sprite sheet for a cozy Cat 2048 mobile game. STYLE: clean Q-version chibi mobile-game cats, same artist for every cell, soft cel shading, thin dark-brown contours, matte fur, upper-left key light, simple readable shapes. Not watercolor, not photoreal, not 3D clay. POSE for every cat: complete seated full-body cat, three-quarter view facing slightly left, round head, short limbs, tail fully visible, both ears complete, friendly open eyes, small muzzle. Same camera, same body proportions, same scale. SHEET: exactly one square image, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, exactly nine cats, left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Genuinely transparent background. No grass, no ground oval, no drop shadow, no white sticker outline, no circular plate, no card, no border, no visible grid lines, no cell dividers, no numbers, no text, no labels, no watermark, no logo, no extra animals, no humans, no furniture. Each cat is centered in its own cell and occupies about 72 percent of that cell. Keep at least 12 percent empty transparent padding on all four sides of every cell. No paw, ear, tail, whisker, sparkle, or accessory may touch or cross a cell edge. No overlap between neighboring cats. No particles in the gutters. No duplicate cats. No cropped anatomy. Readable after cropping to about 80 pixels.

THEME: classic natural cat-breed almanac. Cells 1-8 use real coat colors only. Cell 9 is the first gentle fantasy evolution. Row 1: (1) Orange tabby, warm orange stripes, cream chest and muzzle, amber-brown eyes. (2) Blue-and-white British shorthair, round gray-blue face, white blaze and white paws, dense short coat, golden eyes. (3) Calico, white body with distinct orange and dark-brown patches, amber eyes. Row 2: (4) Ragdoll, very fluffy cream-white body, soft brown-gray ear tips and tail, blue eyes, longer fur but the same seated silhouette, no sticker outline. (5) Siamese, cream body, dark brown points on ears, face mask, paws and tail, blue almond eyes, slimmer face, same chibi body. (6) American shorthair brown tabby, warm brown-gold classic tabby markings, bold forehead M, green-amber eyes. Row 3: (7) Tuxedo cow cat, crisp black-and-white tuxedo, white chest and paws, pink inner ears, round golden eyes, no collar, no bow. (8) Bombay black cat, sleek solid black coat, pink inner ears, rich copper-red eyes, no accessories. (9) Galaxy aurora cat, same seated body, deep indigo-violet fur with soft star sparkles inside the coat not floating outside, white chest, purple eyes, no halo, no wings. Only breed, coat, and eye color change.
